title: Clarify caught-primary preservation and accounting requirements
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Clarifies two resolved original G12 scope questions using the retained source reviews: the narrow protocol repair preserves an already-caught primary against newly added bookkeeping failures; it does not impose a universal interpreter allocation-equivalence proof. The custody clarification does not make a newly constructed enclosing financial/accounting API an original source-adoption prerequisite.

Authentic reference transport, primary/raw-secondary identities, ownership, cleanup, source/mode/output custody, terminal order and a complete work/cost bill remain required. The conditional witnesses in #6347 remain valid within their stated interpretation. No original design predicate is silently removed, and no remaining integration, family, activity or runtime gate is accepted.

## Task and overlap

Original source investigation: [PR #6321](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6321). Frozen H25 benchmark: [PR #6029](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6029). Immediate predecessors: [PR #6346](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6346), [PR #6347](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6347).

Explicit user request: submit the resolved questions upstream, then consult Pro on the remaining compiler-input closure witness domain.

- Canonical base: `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`.
- Public head: `1e9db2d08be4551ffe0bcfc573574851530eb4ca`; checked tree `c9dedd702d5146234c249f52ffe73a453eb77579`.
- Seven new files under `research/h25-g12-original-contract-scope/`; three unchanged canonical review inputs are live declared replay dependencies.
- Nearest lineage: #6321; #6339 at `608ad23adc6c01264c8195daf7f18e29c17464a7` is now archivally merged. #6346 `abff67b31fa781e950c82d95eccb6f168950943c` and #6347 `59140439e7f791876159e2f3838f1dead2e54953` remain separate pending contributions. This package neither requires nor reruns them.
- Scope is changed from the retained portable-replay card to this explicitly assigned fixed-source review audit. Current rules and base were refreshed; bounded all-state G12-scope and H25-bootstrap-control campaign searches are not proof of novelty.

## Validation

Python 3.12.3; executed:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/h25-g12-original-contract-scope --check-only
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/h25-g12-original-contract-scope
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/h25-g12-original-contract-scope
```

Metadata/pins and registered normal/optimized replay pass. Each mode reports `source_inputs=3 tamper_controls=6 target_execution=false original_acceptance=false`. The committed-byte preflight checked 10 package/input files. Remote branch readback confirms the exact checked tree and one parent at the canonical base. Hosted checks are pending at submission.

This is passive JSON/source binding and an inspectable textual scope argument. It is not a natural-language proof engine, exception-safety runtime test, original control execution, native/compiler/scientific work, source adoption or a new budget. Unknown physical/final costs remain OPEN_NOT_ZERO. Original selections remain None.

## Credit

Chris R / Clear1nsight, with substantial OpenAI Codex source-audit/verification and ChatGPT Pro consultation assistance. Retain PR6321/6029/5864 source authors/reviewers, unpaidmoon with Cursor Grok assistance for #6339, and Douglas R. Colkitt's circuit/network/verification lineage. Canonical predecessor bytes/notices remain unchanged; new analysis/verifier Apache-2.0. AI agreement is not human or proof-kernel acceptance.

## Open next questions

Review a concrete successor against original CP01-CP15 and all 18 branch obligations. First step: exact caught-primary/raw-secondary/cleanup source review without the two additional scope requirements identified here. Full integration, runtime, cost and adoption dispositions remain separate. See README and TASK.json.
